name: CSO_DELETION_HISTORY
description: This table is used to store history of deleted records from other tables such as TAG.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID of a user who deleted a record from a table.

columns.name: DATE_DELETED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the ID_DELETED record was deleted from the table identified by TABLE_NAME.

columns.name: TABLE_NAME
columns.description: This is the name of the database table from which the ID_DELETED record was removed.

columns.name: ID_DELETED
columns.description: The record ID that was deleted from the table identified by TABLE_NAME.

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE
columns.description: A record type used in code and for business use to track deletion.

columns.name: ENTITY_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: A record sub type used in code and for business use to track deletion.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Extra information on the record that was removed.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of a user who deleted a record from a table.
